docs.title: Cloud Modernization Documentation Index
docs.summary: Central resource portal for architecture, setup procedures, and cluster management.
docs.content: Welcome to the Cloud Infrastructure Modernization documentation repository. This portal contains all operational guides, architecture specifications, deployment steps, and database configurations required to maintain and scale our Kubernetes environment.

setup.title: Cluster Environment Setup Guide
setup.summary: Prerequisites, CLI tools, and authentication configuration for local and staging access.
setup.content: To interact with the modernization clusters, install kubectl v1.30+, Terraform 1.8+, and the AWS CLI v2. Authenticate using corporate SSO tokens via aws sso login --profile production-devops. Verify cluster connectivity using kubectl cluster-info.

setup/database.title: Database Provisioning and Migration
setup/database.summary: Detailed runbook for Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL setup, secrets rotation, and connection pooling.
setup/database.content: All databases are managed through Terraform in /infra/rds. Connection strings are injected via Kubernetes external secrets manager syncing with AWS Secrets Manager. Always test migrations locally before running goose up against staging.

architecture.title: Multi-Region Cloud Architecture
architecture.summary: High-level topology diagrams, edge routing with Cloudflare, and Istio service mesh configuration.
architecture.content: The architecture uses active-passive multi-region deployments between us-east-1 and us-west-2. Traffic is routed via Route53 latency-based routing through Cloudflare CDN, terminating into AWS ALB and Istio ingress gateways.

docs.title: Mobile App v2.0 Technical Documentation
docs.summary: Architecture specifications, state management paradigms, and testing guidelines.
docs.content: This repository documents the React Native and native module architecture for the Mobile Banking 2.0 release. It highlights security protocols, biometric hardware interaction, and offline cache consistency.

setup.title: Mobile Developer Environment Setup
setup.summary: Xcode, Android Studio, CocoaPods, and mock API emulator initialization.
setup.content: Install Node 20+, Xcode 16, and Android Studio Ladybug. Ensure CocoaPods is updated via gem install cocoapods. Run npm run mobile:setup to install dependencies and configure local environment variables.

setup/database.title: Local SQLite and WatermelonDB Caching
setup/database.summary: Schema definitions, encrypted SQLite store, and bidirectional synchronization.
setup/database.content: Local device storage uses SQLCipher with 256-bit AES encryption. Sensitive fields are further hashed using salt keys derived during biometric unlock.

architecture.title: Clean Architecture & State Machine Flow
architecture.summary: Domain driven design patterns, repository layer, and unidirectional data streams.
architecture.content: The application enforces a Clean Architecture pattern with distinct Presentation, Domain, and Data layers. View models communicate with use cases via immutable state flows.

setup/database.title: Ledger Database Schema
setup/database.summary: Double-entry accounting ledger tables, immutable transaction journals, and audit tables.
setup/database.content: The ledger database enforces strict double-entry accounting. Modifying historical rows is prohibited by database triggers; corrections must be issued as compensatory transactions.
